title: TL;DR & 3 Action Items
description: Generates a punchy 3-bullet summary with actionable takeaways.
prompt: Provide a well-explained summary of this page followed by 3 thoroughly detailed, actionable takeaways with bold headings and complete explanatory sentences (no single-word bullets).

title: Fact Check Page
description: Highlights key factual claims and flags potential ambiguities, unsupported assertions, or unverified points.
prompt: Identify the top 5 factual assertions made in this content. Evaluate whether adequate sources or evidence are provided on this page, and flag any potential biases or claims that require external verification.

title: Fill Form with Profile
description: Scans interactive inputs on the active page and fills them using your local Profile Vault data.
prompt: Fill out this form using the information stored in my profile vault. Match fields like my name, email, phone, location, and social links.

title: Hinglish Explainer
description: Simplifies complex academic or legal text into everyday conversational Hinglish.
prompt: Explain the core message of this page in everyday conversational Hinglish (Roman/Latin script). Break down technical jargon into simple everyday examples.

title: Draft Thoughtful Reply
description: Drafts a constructive, professional comment or reply based on the page content.
prompt: Draft a thoughtful, constructive reply to the highlighted topic, keeping a respectful and professional tone.
